scenario: idle daemon without a configured Yocto workspace

decision.blocking_pool: Tokio lazy blocking pool; no blocking-pool thread existed in either idle sample
decision.reason: one worker may be occupied by a bounded synchronous terminal or daemon-listener poll, while the second must continue reactor, input, IPC, and timer work
non_goals: do not increase worker count to hide blocking work
do not move measured expensive filesystem or process work back from spawn_blocking
do not create a permanent blocking-pool thread while idle
